data.title: Rupiah price format
story: The till screen must show prices like Rp 25.000, with a dot every three digits.
data.solution:
def format_rupiah(amount):
    text = str(amount)
    result = ""
    while len(text) > 3:
        result = "." + text[-3:] + result
        text = text[:-3]
    return "Rp " + text + result

explanation: Repeatedly take the last three digits and put a dot in front, until three digits or fewer remain.
hints: text[-3:] is the last three characters, text[:-3] is the rest.
